events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in August 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. What's your favourite moment or performance from the legendary festival?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day, the music world remembers the passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, whose powerful lyrics and artistry left an indelible mark on music.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar icon whose music continues to electrify.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is as legendary as the tracks within. Which is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Rock icon Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders turns 75 today! Still sounding incredible.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! Still bringing the rock'n'roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that changed our music habits forever. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The music world remembers John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped. A double album full of diverse tracks. Which one is your go-to?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the legendary Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.
